name: @metrum/ledgerline-feature-shell
//: Entry points are ng-packagr's Angular Package Format output, derived from the package name — same arrangement and same reasoning as @metrum/ui. See libs/shared/ui/README.md.
//peerDependencies: Angular is a peer for the reason in libs/shared/ui/README.md — a second copy in its own node_modules breaks DI and instanceof. The three @metrum packages are peers because this lib does not bundle them: ng-packagr leaves them external, the consuming app has them in its own graph, and npm workspaces symlinks all three at the root so one copy is resolved either way.
